anya: EDR alert on laptop-jordan: kernel driver loaded from %TEMP%\u7d3.tmp, process tree svchost.exe -> rundll32.exe -> tmp_u7d3.exe. Host auto-isolated. tagging @mike @iris
sec-bot: [EDR] isolation applied at 2026-03-19T14:12:31Z, rule: driver-load-suspicious, artifact id: art-9f2b
jordan: I just synced a repo and ran local tests. No external USB. Laptop is a Lenovo X1C, Win11.
mike: thx. don't rejoin corp network. can you confirm if Docker or any admin installer ran in last hour?
jordan: only vscode + cargo build, npm install earlier this morning.
iris: check EDR network connections for outbound TLS to uncommon IPs and AD auths. if there's an S3 token exposure, block keys.
anya: paste of EDR event, truncated:
```
process: C:\Windows\System32\rundll32.exe
child: C:\Users\jordan\AppData\Local\Temp\tmp_u7d3.exe
flags: driver_load, elevated_spawn
net: 45.77.12.9:443 (tls), cert CN mismatch
hashes: md5: b1a2... sha256: e3f4...
```

mike: collecting triage bundle (sysinfo, msinfo32, running procs, prefetch, autoruns), uploading to sec bucket.
oncall-sre: FYI allocating spare device for user if we need to reimage. Also starting host scan lab job.
jordan: ok running full EDR scan now, will leave laptop on and connected only to my phone hotspot per instructions.
anya: also check scheduled tasks and registry Run keys for persistence.
iris: if triage finds signed driver with odd signer, escalate to threat intel. notify legal if data exfil candidate.
mike: next steps: 1) complete triage bundle, 2) confirm no AD lateral logins, 3) if artifacts match known droppers we'll reimage. ETA 45m.
sec-bot: uploaded triage bundle to s3://redwood-sec/triage/1865002345/artifacts.zip
anya: thanks all. jordan pls DM me device serial and confirm any USB activity after 8am. I'll open the incident ticket and backlog remediation tasks.
jordan: sent serial and list of recent commands. no USB.
mike: scan returned 1 suspicious PE in temp dir with network beacon pattern. quarantined locally. pushing hash to IOC feed.
iris: good. add prompt to dev onboarding to avoid running random postinstall scripts; assign to devex.
anya: incident ticket opened INC-2026-0423, we will reconvene after full analysis. closing thread for now :white_check_mark:
